rules.official_player_identity: Official batting/pitching/fielding/running tables joined by KBO player ID, not name.
rules.provider_crosswalk: Name/team candidates are unverified and never overwrite provider IDs or per-game rows.
rules.team_identity: Explicit KBO team abbreviation to existing full team name and ID mapping.
rules.transfer_scope: Official player totals are season-wide. Do not assign them to individual provider team stints.
rules.raw_games: Original provider JSON is preserved; official/games contains verified official replacements for all 720 games.
rules.missing_game: The missing provider game is available under official/games/sr_sport_event_67204148.json; provider IDs not inferred.
rules.omitted_stats: Absent official category is null, not zero; player fielding games are per-position, not additive appearances.
rules.field_semantics: Batting strikeouts and pitcher strikeouts are separate fields. No conversion of ambiguous provider strikeouts.

remaining_work: Confirm cross-provider player IDs using independent identity evidence.
Compare official per-game boxscores before editing individual game JSON.
Team batting BB and SO are not exposed in the downloaded team batting page; not verified.

game_reconciliation.validation: 720 official boxscores verified. All tested additive batting, hits allowed, home runs allowed, pitching outs, strikeouts and run totals agree with official season team totals. Individual pitcher ER sums are distinct from team ER.
